memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine follow‑up for obesity and hypothyroidism. EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 92 kg, height 1.58 m, BMI 36.8 (obese). Waist circumference 98 cm. Skin dry, no pallor. IMPRESSION: 1) Obesity, class II. 2) Hypothyroidism on levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, TSH pending. ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile, fasting glucose, HbA1c, liver function tests, TSH, free T4. Continue orlistat 120 mg with each main meal. Advise reduced calorie intake and 150 min/week brisk walk. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

Liver: ALT 38 U/L (<40), AST 34 U/L (<37), ALP 84 U/L (<120), GGT 32 U/L (<51). TSH 6.8 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0). Free T4 11.2 pmol/L (12‑22).

memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Weight check and thyroid follow‑up. EXAMINATION: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 91.5 kg, BMI 36.6 (obese). Waist 97 cm. Skin less dry. No edema. IMPRESSION: Obesity stable. Hypothyroidism: TSH improved but still slightly high on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat TSH, free T4, lipid panel, fasting glucose, HbA1c, LFT. Continue orlistat. Increase levothyroxine to 100 mcg OD. Reinforce diet and activity. Return if palpitations, excessive sweating, weight loss >2 kg/month, or severe fatigue.

memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review. EXAMINATION: BP 126/80 mmHg, weight 90.0 kg, BMI 36.0 (obese). Waist 95 cm. No thyroid enlargement. IMPRESSION: Obesity modest improvement. Hypothyroidism euthyroid on levothyroxine 100 mcg OD. ARRANGEMENTS: Check TSH and free T4 in 3 months, lipid profile, fasting glucose, HbA1c, LFT. Continue current meds. Encourage Mediterranean diet and strength training twice weekly. Return if new palpitations, heat intolerance, unexplained weight change, or severe constipation.

memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Slight weight gain and fatigue. EXAMINATION: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 92.0 kg, BMI 36.8 (obese). Waist 99 cm. Skin mildly dry. IMPRESSION: Obesity worsened. Hypothyroidism: TSH rising suggestive of suboptimal control. ARRANGEMENTS: Check TSH, free T4, lipid panel, fasting glucose, HbA1c, LFT. Continue orlistat. Increase levothyroxine to 100 mcg OD (maintain) and counsel on adherence. Reinforce low‑carb diet and daily walking. Return if palpitations, heat intolerance, severe constipation, or unexplained weight loss.
